title: Happy Memories
setting: A quiet riverbank near a small wooden house.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Ali and his wife Rosa sit by the river.
sentences.zh: 阿里和妻子罗莎坐在河边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt sit together on the grassy bank of a calm river.

sentences.en: They remember their trip to a hot country.
sentences.zh: 他们想起了去一个炎热国家的旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt smile and look up dreamily by the river, a sunny hot land in a thought bubble.

sentences.en: During the trip, they rode a big elephant.
sentences.zh: 旅行期间，他们骑过一头大象。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt ride on the back of a big elephant in a hot sunny land.

sentences.en: Rosa also rode a white horse one day.
sentences.zh: 有一天，罗莎还骑了一匹白马。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt rides a white horse on a dusty path under a hot sun.

sentences.en: Each night, they slept in the same small house.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，他们都睡在同一座小房子里。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small house at night with lit windows, Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt walking toward its door.

sentences.en: The house had only one big bed.
sentences.zh: 那座房子里只有一张大床。
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside a small simple room with one big bed, Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt looking at it and laughing.

sentences.en: Now they laugh and remember those happy days.
sentences.zh: 现在他们笑着回忆那些快乐的日子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt laugh together by the river at sunset.
